mapper.select: /* Tbm01Mapper.selectTbmEduDetail */ SELECT A.CMPNY_CD AS cmpnyCd , A.MTRL_CD AS mtrlCd , A.TITLE AS title , A.CONTENTS AS contents , A.MTRL_TYPE AS mtrlType , A.USE_YN AS useYn , ( SELECT COUNT(I.MTRL_ITEM_CD) FROM TB_TBM_EDU_MTRL_ITEM I /* 테넌트 격리: MTRL_CD 는 회사별 채번이라 전역 유일하지 않다. 항목의 CMPNY_CD 로 함께 좁힌다. */ WHERE I.CMPNY_CD = A.CMPNY_CD AND I.MTRL_CD = A.MTRL_CD AND I.USE_YN = 'Y' ) AS mtrlCnt , A.SITE_CD AS siteCd , CASE WHEN A.SITE_CD IS NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS isCommonContent , A.TITLE AS oriTitle , A.CONTENTS AS oriContents , A.MTRL_TYPE AS oriMtrlType , A.USE_YN AS oriUseYn , FNC_CMM_INFO_SRCH(A.CMPNY_CD, 'USER_NM', A.INSERT_NO, NULL) AS insertNm , DATE_FORMAT(A.INSERT_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS insertDate /* T5-2: 사용 중(취소 외 세션 참조) 여부. 'Y'면 수정/삭제 잠금 */ , ( SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(1) > 0 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END FROM TB_TBM_SESSION_CONTENT SC INNER JOIN TB_TBM_SESSION S ON (SC.CMPNY_CD = S.CMPNY_CD AND SC.SESSION_CD = S.SESSION_CD) WHERE SC.CMPNY_CD = A.CMPNY_CD AND SC.MTRL_CD = A.MTRL_CD AND S.DEL_YN = 'N' AND S.STATUS_CD != 'CANCELLED' ) AS lockedYn /* TBM_AI F1: 교육안 재열람(record 말미 순서 정합) */ , A.GEN_CONTENT AS genContent , DATE_FORMAT(A.GEN_AT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS genAt FROM TB_TBM_EDU_MTRL A WHERE A.CMPNY_CD = #{gvCmpnyCd} AND A.MTRL_CD = #{mtrlCd}

/* Tbm01Mapper.selectTbmEduUsedSessions */ SELECT S.SESSION_CD AS sessionCd , S.TITLE AS title , S.STATUS_CD AS statusCd , S.SITE_CD AS siteCd , DATE_FORMAT(S.OPENED_AT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS openedAt , DATE_FORMAT(S.ENDED_AT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS endedAt , SC.DISPLAY_ORDER AS displayOrder FROM TB_TBM_SESSION_CONTENT SC INNER JOIN TB_TBM_SESSION S ON ( SC.CMPNY_CD = S.CMPNY_CD AND SC.SESSION_CD = S.SESSION_CD ) WHERE SC.CMPNY_CD = #{gvCmpnyCd} AND SC.MTRL_CD = #{mtrlCd} AND S.DEL_YN = 'N' ORDER BY S.INSERT_DATE DESC
